description: Test vectors for the post quantum signature verification builtins. Encoding vectors fix the versioned object layout for every identifier. Verification vectors fix the result of each builtin, where true and false are returned values and failure means evaluation fails. Rejection vectors are malformed objects that every builtin must refuse. Keys come from fixed seeds and signatures use the deterministic signing variant of FIPS 204 and FIPS 205 with an empty context string, so every vector can be reproduced.

encoding.description: A well formed ML-DSA-44 public key decodes to identifier 0x0001, kind 0x01 and a 1312 byte body
A well formed ML-DSA-44 signature decodes to identifier 0x0001, kind 0x02 and a 2420 byte body
A well formed ML-DSA-65 public key decodes to identifier 0x0002, kind 0x01 and a 1952 byte body
A well formed ML-DSA-65 signature decodes to identifier 0x0002, kind 0x02 and a 3309 byte body
A well formed ML-DSA-87 public key decodes to identifier 0x0003, kind 0x01 and a 2592 byte body
A well formed ML-DSA-87 signature decodes to identifier 0x0003, kind 0x02 and a 4627 byte body
A well formed SLH-DSA-SHA2-128s public key decodes to identifier 0x0004, kind 0x01 and a 32 byte body
A well formed SLH-DSA-SHA2-128s signature decodes to identifier 0x0004, kind 0x02 and a 7856 byte body

verification.description: verifyMlDsaSignature returns true for a genuine ML-DSA-44 signature over the message
verifyMlDsaSignature returns false when one bit of the message is changed, so the signature binds the exact message
verifyMlDsaSignature returns false when one bit of the ML-DSA-44 signature body is changed, so a modified signature is never accepted
verifyMlDsaSignature returns true for a genuine ML-DSA-65 signature over the message
verifyMlDsaSignature returns false when one bit of the message is changed, so the signature binds the exact message
verifyMlDsaSignature returns false when one bit of the ML-DSA-65 signature body is changed, so a modified signature is never accepted
verifyMlDsaSignature returns true for a genuine ML-DSA-87 signature over the message
verifyMlDsaSignature returns false when one bit of the message is changed, so the signature binds the exact message
verifyMlDsaSignature returns false when one bit of the ML-DSA-87 signature body is changed, so a modified signature is never accepted
verifySlhDsaSignature returns true for a genuine SLH-DSA-SHA2-128s signature over the message
verifySlhDsaSignature returns false when one bit of the message is changed, so the signature binds the exact message
verifySlhDsaSignature returns false when one bit of the SLH-DSA-SHA2-128s signature body is changed, so a modified signature is never accepted
verifyMlDsaSignature returns false for a genuine ML-DSA-65 signature checked against a different ML-DSA-65 public key
Evaluation fails when the public key and the signature declare different schemes, ML-DSA-44 and ML-DSA-65
Evaluation fails when an SLH-DSA key and signature are passed to the ML-DSA builtin, since each builtin serves only its own family
Evaluation fails when a signature object is given in the public key position, since the kind byte must match its position

rejection.description: Identifier 0x0000 is reserved and never valid
Kind 0x03 is neither a public key nor a signature
An ML-DSA-44 public key body one byte shorter than 1312 bytes
An ML-DSA-44 public key body one byte longer than 1312 bytes
An object shorter than its four byte header
